title: Agent Skill Frontmatter
description: YAML frontmatter for skill.md files. Follows the agentskills.io open standard (https://agentskills.io/specification) with registry-specific extensions for version, tags, and author.

name.description: Unique skill identifier. Must match the directory name exactly. Lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only. No leading, trailing, or consecutive hyphens.

description.description: What the skill does and when to use it. Used by agents for progressive-disclosure discovery. Be specific and include trigger keywords.

version.description: Semantic version (major.minor.patch). Increment per semver rules — MAJOR for breaking behavior changes, MINOR for new behaviors, PATCH for wording tweaks.

tags.description: Lowercase tags for marketplace discoverability (e.g. [crestron, av, testing]).

author.description: GitHub username or org of the skill author.

license.description: License name or reference to a bundled license file (e.g. 'MIT', 'Apache-2.0'). Per agentskills.io spec.

compatibility.description: Environment requirements: intended agent product, required system packages, network access needs. Per agentskills.io spec. Omit if no special requirements.

allowed-tools.description: Space-separated list of tools the skill is pre-approved to use (e.g. 'Bash(git:*) Read'). Experimental field per agentskills.io spec.

homepage.description: URL to the skill's source repository or documentation.

deprecated.description: Set to true to exclude this skill from the registry and marketplace. The skill files remain in the repo for reference. See CONTRIBUTING.md for the deprecation process.

metadata.description: Registry-tracking fields required by the Skill Compliance Checklist (Confluence CAAD-2931658766, Appendix C1-C6).

team.description: Owning team name. Required for C1 checklist approval.

maintainer.description: Designated maintainer GitHub username. Required for C1 checklist approval.

dependencies.description: Comma-separated list of tools and APIs the skill invokes, with pinned versions where applicable (e.g. 'git, docker, GitHub API'). Use 'None' if there are no dependencies. No floating 'latest' or unpinned ranges (^, ~, >=) per C4. Required for C1 checklist approval.

scope-allow.description: Systems/files/APIs this skill may access (e.g. 'skills/**/skill.md', 'GitHub REST API'). Required for C2 scope-boundary declaration.

scope-deny.description: Systems/files/APIs this skill must NOT access. Use ['None declared'] if genuinely unrestricted (discouraged). Required for C2 scope-boundary declaration.

input-schema.description: Free-text or JSON-pointer description of the skill's input contract (parameter names/types/validation rules). Use 'None' for parameterless skills. Required for C1.

output-schema.description: Free-text or JSON-pointer description of the skill's output shape. Required for C1.

output-max-size.description: Declared maximum output size (e.g. '10KB', 'unbounded'). Must be explicit. Required for C1/C2.

test-strategy.description: How this skill is tested. 'manual' is only valid when the skill bundles no executable scripts. Required for C3.

test-coverage.description: Line coverage percentage from the automated test suite. Required when test-strategy is 'automated' or 'hybrid'.

tested-by.description: GitHub username of the person who performed the manual behavioral eval. Required when test-strategy is 'manual' or 'hybrid'.

test-date.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) the manual eval was performed. Required when test-strategy is 'manual' or 'hybrid'.

idempotent.description: Whether repeated invocation with identical inputs is safe. Required for C2.

duplicate-invocation-safeguard.description: Required when idempotent is false: describes how duplicate invocations are made safe (dedup key, confirmation gate, etc.).

destructive-operations.description: List of destructive operations this skill (or its bundled scripts) can perform (e.g. 'deletes files via clear-locale-files.ps1'). Use ['None'] if there are none. Required for C2/C6 — must match what static security scanning finds in bundled scripts.

approved-by.description: GitHub username of the approving AI Workgroup member. Required once a skill leaves draft status (C1/C5).

approval-date.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) of C1-C6 checklist approval.

deprecation-notice-date.description: ISO date the deprecation notice was issued. Required when 'deprecated' transitions to true (C4: 60-day notice).

removal-date.description: ISO date the skill will be removed. Must be >= deprecation-notice-date + 60 days (C4).

source-repo.description: Set only for skills mirrored from a team's own repo via sync-skill.yml. URL of the source repository. Skills with this set are locked to sync-only — see CONTRIBUTING.md.

source-ref.description: Commit SHA or tag in the source repo this mirror was last synced from. Set alongside source-repo.

source-path.description: Path within the source repo to the skill's directory, if not at the repo root. Set alongside source-repo.

synced-at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last sync from source-repo.
